feature_queries.name: study_static
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  tt.nct_id,
  tt.timestamp,
  EXTRACT(year FROM tt.timestamp) AS asof_year,
  s.study_type,
  s.phase,
  s.enrollment,
  s.enrollment_type,
  s.source,
  s.source_class,
  s.has_dmc,
  s.is_fda_regulated_drug,
  s.is_fda_regulated_device,
  s.is_unapproved_device,
  s.is_ppsd,
  s.is_us_export,
  s.fdaaa801_violation,
  s.plan_to_share_ipd,
  s.number_of_arms,
  s.number_of_groups,
  datediff('day', s.start_date, tt.timestamp) AS days_since_start
FROM eval_table tt
LEFT JOIN studies s
  ON s.nct_id = tt.nct_id

feature_queries.name: sponsor_counts
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  tt.nct_id,
  tt.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.sponsor_id) AS n_sponsors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.agency_class='NIH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sponsors_nih,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.agency_class='INDUSTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sponsors_industry,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.agency_class='OTHER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sponsors_other
FROM eval_table tt
LEFT JOIN sponsors_studies ss
  ON ss.nct_id = tt.nct_id
LEFT JOIN sponsors sp
  ON sp.sponsor_id = ss.sponsor_id
GROUP BY tt.nct_id, tt.timestamp

feature_queries.name: condition_intervention_counts
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  tt.nct_id,
  tt.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.condition_id) AS n_conditions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT isx.intervention_id) AS n_interventions
FROM eval_table tt
LEFT JOIN conditions_studies cs
  ON cs.nct_id = tt.nct_id
LEFT JOIN interventions_studies isx
  ON isx.nct_id = tt.nct_id
GROUP BY tt.nct_id, tt.timestamp
